notes: Table 5 col 1: outcome F.misconduct = indicator for >= 1 firm misconduct event in t+1 (LPM). Firm-level panel of RIA firms with <= 50 employees (Form ADV), 2009-2020, firm CRD fcrdn x year; treatment top1000_owner = firm owned by a Barron's Top-1000 advisor in year t. Prepared data (work dir build_data.R): final_firm_level_sample.dta, drop rows with number_employee > 50 OR missing (Stata's '>50' is true for missing; 16,310 rows dropped, 127,229 kept), then the t+1 lead exactly as Stata's f. under xtset fcrdn year: y of the same firm in year+1 in the FILTERED panel, missing when that year is absent (gap, exit, or year+1 dropped by the employee filter). The sample restriction is built into the prepared file, so sample_filter is empty; adoption is dated on this filtered panel. Pipeline deviations: (1) Hull fn 6: treatment switches off (152 switch-off events, 496 post-adoption rows with top1000_owner = 0 in the filtered panel); run_spec drops post-adoption rows with D = 0; (2) the authors' year#grp_state FE use the firm's CURRENT state, which varies within firm for 1,433 of 21,865 firms (27 of 278 ever-treated); the pipeline uses xt = grp_state_first (first non-missing state in year order) so the state x year FE are a fixed characteristic x year; rows with missing grp_state (6,534 rows) keep NA and drop, as in the authors' absorb(). twfe_variants decomposes the effect: A authors, B fixed state, D switch-offs dropped, C both (pipeline). Year 2020 rows have no t+1 outcome, so the estimation years are 2009-2019 and firms first treated in 2020 (8) are never-treated in the pipeline (their only treated rows lack an outcome in the authors' regression too). 104 of 278 ever-treated firms are treated in their first observed year (37 in 2009 = always-treated in the sample window; the rest enter treated later and have no pre-period). Excluded from the pipeline: Table 2 col 1 (no firm FE), col 3 (adds l_top1000_owner), col 4 and Table 5 col 2 (ppmlhdfe Poisson); advisor-level Tables 3-7 (continuous norm_ranking, time-varying license/tenure controls, RD cutoff); Figures 1-2 (PanelMatch); Table IA8 (stacked).
